documents.title: Returns policy
documents.content: Returns are accepted within 30 days. Keep your receipt for a return.

documents.title: Shipping policy
documents.content: Standard shipping takes 3 business days. Express shipping takes 1 business day.

documents.title: Index maintenance
documents.content: Changing the embedding model requires reindexing every document. The query and worker must use the same pipeline signature.
